newsitem.title: FRANCE: Thomson-CSF says 1996 new orders stable. [CORRECTED 13:50 GMT]
newsitem.headline: Thomson-CSF says 1996 new orders stable. [CORRECTED 13:50 GMT]

text.p: (Corrects headline to "1996 new orders" from "1996 sales".)
Thomson-CSF said in a statement that its total new orders for 1996 were 33.2 billion francs.
This compares with a headline figure of 43.2 billion of 1995 but this included the exceptional 10-year deal Sawaro II, for 9.9 billion francs, for the delivery of frigates to Saudi Arabia.
"Those big deals are far and few between. If you strip the exceptional element of Sawari II out of the figures, the new orders were stable in 1996 compared to 1995," a Thomson-CSF spokesman said.
